subject: Yum Yum
text: If you run up to the right side of Yum Yum while he starts off eating a boar and quickly fire axes at him, you can beat him before he starts his attack.

evidence.quote: He starts off eating a boar, and if you run up to the right side of him and quickly fire axes at him, you should be able to beat him before he even starts his attack!

subject: Yum Yum
text: If not killed in time, Yum Yum runs back and forth shooting out fire bubbles from his mouth that spread across the screen, moving faster and stronger when about to die.

evidence.quote: If you don't get to kill him in time, he'll run back and forth, shooting out fire bubbles from his mouth that spread across the screen...When he is about to die, he'll move faster and stronger, so be careful then.

subject: Scorpion
text: Against the large scorpion, switch to the slingshot and fire away while avoiding and killing the little scorpions that come out of holes in the room.

evidence.quote: He is in a large room, and little scorpions come out of the holes in the room...Switch to the slingshot and fire away on the scorpion, avoiding and killing the little ones that get in your way.

subject: Egyptian Mask
text: Switch to the Shockwave to attack the Egyptian Mask while standing on the conveyor belt.

evidence.quote: The Egyptian Mask is a little challenging due to the conveyor belt that you have to stand on...Switch to the Shockwave and figure out its simple pattern, then start attacking it easily.

subject: Egyptian Mask
text: Once the Egyptian Mask takes decent damage, he turns red, moves across the screen faster, shoots out more bullets, and occasionally fires a blue laser beam from his mouth.

evidence.quote: Once it takes some decent damage, he will go red and start moving across the screen faster. He starts to shoot out more bullets, and he also has a blue laser beam that occasionally comes out of his mouth.

subject: Zoda's Creature
text: Zoda's Creature is in the middle of water surrounded by four appearing and disappearing platforms; jump on one, hit him a few times, jump to the next platform, and jump down to dry ground from the platform below him to repeat.

evidence.quote: He is in the middle of the water, and there are four platforms that appear and disappear around him. You have to jump on one, hit him a few times, jump to the next platform, and repeat...When you get to the platform below him, you can jump down to dry ground and repeat the process.

subject: Zoda
text: Zoda shoots four blue flames from the floor when far away, shoots five skulls out as a short range attack, and teleports around the room a few seconds after an attack.

evidence.quote: One is an attack where he shoots four blue flames out from the floor. He does this when you are far away from him. He also has a short range attack where he shoots five skulls out, but you can jump over them. He also teleports around the room a few seconds after he does an attack.

subject: Zoda
text: Because the flooring has little arrows on every tile, jump near Zoda as soon as he appears, jump over his skeletons, and hit him a few times before he teleports.

evidence.quote: The main tricky part here is the flooring, which have little arrows on every tile, so you will constantly be moving around in whatever direction they see fit...As soon as Zoda appeared, I jumped near him, jumped over his skeletons, and hit him a few times before he teleported.

subject: Miner
text: Stay on the skinny platform aligned with the Miner and hit him normally when he holds the rock up, or jump and shoot when he has it down, jumping over the boulder he throws.

evidence.quote: The only problem is that there's a skinny platform that you must stay on while aligned with him for the whole battle, but it shouldn't be too much of an issue. He will get a boulder from the wall, and throw it at you occasionally, then inch slowly to the right...Just hit him normally when he holds the rock up, and when he has it down, jump and shoot. Jump over the boulder and you can get in a few more sneaky hits as well, if you wish.

subject: Miner Skeleton
text: When the Miner Skeleton slams his hammer into the ground, jump right away to prevent freezing from occurring.

evidence.quote: When the battle starts, he will slam his hammer into the ground. Mike will freeze for a second, boulders will come from the sky, and boulders will come out of his hammer. Yep. The way to prevent this freezing from occurring is by jumping when he throws the hammer down, so jump right away.

subject: Miner Skeleton
text: Use the star to get in hits on the Miner Skeleton with the shockwave weapon without taking damage.

evidence.quote: I hope you saved those medicines and the star, because you can use it now to get in a bunch of hits with the shockwave weapon without taking any damage.

subject: Zoda-Y
text: As soon as you enter the room against Zoda-Y, move forward a little bit because spikes come out of the floor right away.

evidence.quote: First off, as soon as you enter the room, move forward a little bit. This is because a bunch of spikes will come out of the floor right away.

subject: Zoda-Y
text: Hold up as hard as you can when Zoda-Y flaps his wings and shoots out wind to prevent being pushed back into the spikes.

evidence.quote: He'll then flap his wings and shoot out wind that will attempt to push you back to the spikes that came at the start of the battle. Hold up as hard as you can to prevent him from doing this, because you're dead otherwise.

subject: Zoda-Y
text: Use the mace to hit Zoda-Y when he is exposed.

evidence.quote: Instead, focus on hitting Zoda when you can, by using the mace and hitting him when he is exposed.

subject: Knight
text: While standing on the ring of conveyor belts, jump over the bullets the Knight shoots and aim the shockwave diagonally at him.

evidence.quote: The toughest part about this boss is the fact that you'll be standing on a ring of conveyor belts that quickly move you around the room. The knight will simply move back and forth, shooting bullets in two directions. Simply jump over the bullets as they come near you, and aim the shockwave diagonally at him, praying the shots connect.

subject: Dragon
text: Stay near the bottom right hand corner and jump using the ultimate shockwave weapon to hit the Dragon's head, then walk in a circle to avoid bullets when he starts to fly.

evidence.quote: If you don't have many medicines for some reason, stay near the bottom right hand corner and jump while using the ultimate shockwave weapon to hit his head, then when he starts to fly, walk in a circle to avoid the bullets. The only way to kill him is by hitting his head, and the shockwave is the preferred weapon of choice for this task.

subject: C-Serpent
text: Stand on the center tile and throw weapons into the C-Serpent's mouth when it is open, jumping left or right to the other tiles to avoid the fire he shoots.

evidence.quote: There are three tiles, and you can only stand in the center one and throw weapons in the snake's mouth when it's open. However, he shoots out fire from his mouth 80% or so of the time, so you have to jump left or right to the tiles to avoid this fire.

subject: Zoda-Z
text: During Zoda-Z's first form, avoid the matching tiny creatures and focus attacks on the differently colored one.

evidence.quote: There's a bunch of tiny creatures, and one of them is differently colored. Avoid the attacks of the tiny ones that match, and focus on the different colored one. After you hit it a bunch of times, this form will be defeated.

subject: Zoda-Z
text: In Zoda-Z's normal form, attack him with the shockwave weapon over and over while avoiding bullets, and run around to avoid attacks if turned into a boar.

evidence.quote: Just attack him with the shockwave weapon over and over while avoiding the weak bullets he shoots out. He has an attack that sends shockwaves out and turns you into a boar. If this happens, you can't really do much but run around and avoid his attacks.

subject: Zoda-Z
text: In his final minotaur form, do not touch Zoda-Z when he spins around because it makes him invincible, watch for fire shot from both sides of the wall, avoid his head-first charge attack, and attack him with the shockwave.

evidence.quote: Once you take care of that form, he'll turn into a minotaur...If he spins around, this makes him invincible for a little bit, so don't try to touch him until the effect wears off. He can also shoot fire off from both sides of the wall...And finally, he has a charge attack where he'll just come out of nowhere and try to slam into you head first...Attack him with the shockwave when you can, and just be patient.
